user.title: Adaptive RoboVacs
user.description: Starts in observe-only mode. Configure area labels and native vacuum segment mappings before enabling dispatch.

confirm.title: Recheck held vacuum
confirm.description:
Adaptive RoboVacs held {robot} after a cleaning request for {room} failed. {reason}

Only this vacuum is held; other compatible vacuums and rooms remain schedulable. When {robot} is docked, submitting this Repair clears this vacuum's fault without sending a cleaning command. If it is already cleaning and the integration cannot confirm which room it is cleaning, that clean is treated as native-app activity and is not credited to the scheduled room.

error.no_scheduler_halt: This vacuum hold is already cleared. Close this Repair and refresh the Scheduler status.
error.recovery_target_unavailable: The affected vacuum or room is no longer available to Home Assistant. Restore it, then try again.
error.robot_state_unavailable: Home Assistant cannot read the vacuum's current state. Wait for its integration to reconnect, then try again.
error.robot_not_docked_or_cleaning: The vacuum is neither docked nor cleaning. Wait until it docks, or confirm a native-app clean has started, then try again.

confirm.title: Recheck blocked room
confirm.description:
Adaptive RoboVacs blocked {room} because its saved room mapping or cleaning profile could not be used. {reason}

This affects only {room}; vacuums remain available for other compatible rooms. Submitting this Repair refreshes discovery and validates the room without starting a clean.

error.recheck_failed: No compatible vacuum can currently validate this room's mapping and cleaning profile. Restore the mapping or update the room settings, then try again.

confirm.title: Recheck and resume Adaptive RoboVacs
confirm.description:
Adaptive RoboVacs stopped all new scheduler dispatch after a cleaning request failed for {room} with {robot}. {reason}

When the vacuum is docked, submitting this Repair clears the stale halt without sending a cleaning command. Battery, availability, adapter compatibility, occupancy, and Home Assistant area mapping are checked later when a new clean is due. If it is already cleaning and the integration cannot confirm which room it is cleaning, the clean is treated as native-app activity: the halt clears without recording a scheduled room as cleaned and without interrupting the vacuum.

error.no_scheduler_halt: The scheduler halt is already cleared. Close this Repair and refresh the Scheduler status.
error.recovery_target_unavailable: The affected vacuum or room is no longer available to Home Assistant. Restore it, then try again.
error.robot_state_unavailable: Home Assistant cannot read the vacuum's current state. Wait for its integration to reconnect, then try again.
error.robot_not_docked_or_cleaning: The vacuum is neither docked nor cleaning. Wait until it docks, or confirm a native-app clean has started, then try again.

confirm.title: Recheck two-pass compatibility
confirm.description: {room} is configured for two passes, but no compatible vacuum currently serves its floor. This refreshes vacuum discovery and verifies compatibility without sending a cleaning command. Restore a compatible vacuum or change the room's Cleaning passes control to Robot default or 1 pass.

error.recheck_failed: No compatible two-pass vacuum currently serves this room. Restore compatibility or change the room's Cleaning passes control.

notification_delivery_failed.title: Adaptive RoboVacs cannot reach a mobile app

confirm.title: Recheck mobile notification targets
confirm.description: Adaptive RoboVacs could not deliver a required water notification to any registered Home Assistant Companion app. Register or reconnect at least one Companion app, then submit to recheck. Mopping that required confirmation was safely cancelled; vacuuming remains available.

error.recheck_failed: No Companion app notification target is currently available.

confirm.title: Recheck room cleaning profile
confirm.description: {room} is configured with a cleaning program, pass count, fan speed, mode, mop mode, or mop intensity that no vacuum on its floor can currently execute. Restore a compatible vacuum or update the room/robot controls, then submit to recheck without starting a clean.

error.recheck_failed: No compatible vacuum can currently execute this room's complete cleaning profile.

storage_unsafe.title: Adaptive RoboVacs storage needs attention
storage_unsafe.description: Adaptive RoboVacs could not safely validate its saved scheduler state ({reason}). Dispatch is disabled and the original Store has not been overwritten. Back up the Store, repair or remove only this integration's damaged data, then reload the integration.

unresolved_robot_reference.title: Adaptive RoboVacs cannot identify a saved vacuum
unresolved_robot_reference.description: Saved scheduler records for {legacy_key} cannot be matched safely to a current vacuum registry entry. They have been retained but cannot dispatch. Restore the original entity/registry association or re-add that vacuum, then reload the integration.

room_error_recovery.title: Adaptive RoboVacs room needs recovery confirmation

confirm.title: Allow the unfinished room stage to retry

error.awaiting_safe_dock: Resolve the vacuum error and dock it. Wait for stable dock confirmation, then try again.
error.recovery_changed: This interruption has changed. Close this Repair and open the current one.
error.recovery_target_unavailable: The saved room, vacuum, or cleaning stage cannot be matched. Restore the original room and vacuum configuration, then try again.
error.recovery_unavailable: Recovery is unavailable while the integration is stopping or its saved state needs repair.

robot_error_recovery.title: Adaptive RoboVacs interrupted vacuum needs review

confirm.title: Abandon an unassociated interrupted clean
confirm.description:
A saved error on {robot} cannot be safely associated with one room stage. Resolve the physical error and dock the vacuum.

Submitting this Repair abandons that saved attempt without marking a room cleaned or sending a cleaning command. An identified obsolete occurrence is discarded; normal room scheduling may create a fresh clean later. Other independent faults remain in place.

error.awaiting_safe_dock: Resolve the vacuum error and dock it. Wait for stable dock confirmation, then try again.
error.recovery_changed: This interruption has changed. Close this Repair and open the current one.
error.recovery_target_unavailable: The saved room, vacuum, or cleaning stage cannot be matched. Restore the original room and vacuum configuration, then try again.
error.recovery_unavailable: Recovery is unavailable while the integration is stopping or its saved state needs repair.

retired_map_hold.title: Confirm the vacuum map after upgrading

confirm.title: Confirm localization and room mapping
confirm.description: Map snapshots and map-selection controls have been removed. {robot} still has an unconfirmed map selection from an older version. Check that the robot is correctly localized on the intended map and that its Home Assistant room mapping is correct. With the robot docked or idle and no tracked clean active, submit this Repair to recheck the mapping and release only this hold. This sends no physical command and starts no clean.

error.recovery_unavailable: Recovery is unavailable while the integration is shutting down or its saved state is unsafe.
error.recovery_changed: This hold changed or was already cleared. Close and reopen the current Repair.
error.awaiting_safe_dock: Restore the vacuum and wait until it is docked or idle with no tracked clean active.
error.mapping_invalid: Home Assistant room mapping is missing, stale, or ambiguous. Correct it before confirming.
